key_highlights: ASX set to open higher with tech stocks leading after Wall Street surge; oil snapped its losing run
RBA rate hikes continue squeezing household spending, but no evidence of wage-price spiral
Global diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine conflicts projected to persist into 2027, pressuring energy costs
Iron ore downside risk persists, weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Active gold exploration pipeline: Platina (Rio cheque), Dalaroo (Côte d'Ivoire/Greenland rare earths), Broken Hill (SA gold), Larvotto (NSW antimony-gold)
Sydney housing market under severe stress; federal/state governments facing debt cliff
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees; Virgin crew complaints
China economic cracks widen; Trump-Xi summit substance debated; China rebalancing towards robotics

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces continued downside pressure, but gold and rare earths exploration activity is robust. Platina secured final $2M Rio cheque for WA gold; Dalaroo advancing Côte d'Ivoire gold and Greenland rare earths; Broken Hill lifted SA gold resource; Larvotto produced first NSW antimony-gold concentrate; Advance hit 4120g/t silver in Mexico.
sectors.implications: Diversification away from iron ore exposure is prudent. Small/mid-cap gold and rare earths names offer optionality but carry execution risk. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore weakness.

sectors.trend: Oil prices sliding but Saudi shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) create volatile two-way risk. Energy prices dumping ahead of potential US Democrat sweep. Diesel shortage projected into 2027.
sectors.implications: Woodside.AX, Santos.AX face mixed signals. Diesel scarcity supports upstream but pressures downstream refiners and transport. Fuel cost inflation a household headwind.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending; no wage-price spiral confirmed. Government debt cliff pressures fiscal backdrop. Community housing eviction risk rising.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face rising NPL risk from stressed households. Fiscal deterioration could pressure sovereign credit and bond yields.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks leading ASX higher post Wall Street surge. Albanese pushing AI governance. Data centres straining net-zero targets. China rebalancing towards robotics.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SPL.AX) benefit from global tech momentum. AI regulation could create compliance costs but also new opportunities. China robotics shift may impact supply chains.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; Virgin crew complaints. High prices altering consumer habits (chocolate). El Niino threatening agricultural supply. Pain trade surging.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk. WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. CSL.AX benefits from pain management demand surge.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' phase. Community housing more likely to threaten eviction than public housing. RBA tightening continues to suppress affordability.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Residential construction names under stress. Monitor RBA commentary for easing signals.

key_themes: Oil/diesel volatility as dominant macro risk
Iron ore structural downside vs. gold/rare earths exploration boom
RBA tightening cycle straining household balance sheets
Fiscal sustainability concerns across federal and state governments
China economic fragility and trade rebalancing
Industrial action in transport sector (Jetstar, Virgin)
AI governance and data centre energy demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel shortage and oil price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour upstream energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over downstream; monitor OPEC+ and Iran/Ukraine developments
Reduce concentration in BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold/rare earths exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate pressure on household spending and NPLs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL trends; favour dividend-paying large caps (CBA.AX, BHP.AX) over rate-sensitive small caps
Underweight residential REITs; monitor core logic and property developer exposure
Watch for bond yield spikes; favour inflation-hedged assets; monitor budget signals
Monitor QAN.AX earnings guidance; short-term volatility may create entry points

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Active pipeline (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto) with iron ore weakness driving capital rotation into precious metals and critical minerals

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech exposure on global momentum
opportunities.rationale: Tech leading ASX post Wall Street surge; AI governance framework may create regulatory tailwinds for compliant players

opportunities.recommendation: CSL.AX on pain trade surge and healthcare demand
opportunities.rationale: Pain management trade roaring; cancer warning labels on alcohol may shift consumer health spending; defensive quality

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore concentration; hedge with gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists amid China weakness; gold provides inverse correlation and inflation hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and rate-sensitive small caps
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing bloodbath and RBA tightening create headwinds; NPL risk rising in banks

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer for oil-driven volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: Diesel shortage to 2027 and Saudi shock create unpredictable energy price swings; preserve dry powder

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to trade range-bound with tech outperforming. Oil/diesel volatility dominates. RBA tightening keeps a lid on rate-sensitive sectors. Jetstar/Virgin industrial action adds transport noise. Net: cautious, +1-2% over 3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift from iron ore to gold/rare earths/energy transition. Fiscal debt concerns and housing correction cap upside. China rebalancing and AI adoption are medium-term positives. Expect 3-5% ASX 200 return over 12 months with high dispersion across sectors.
